author: /root
claims: The original negative fields, moving physical domains, material labels, cut pairs and radii are retained.
Positive canonical endpoints are exactly 0 and 1, while physical endpoints retain their original interval.
The chart, inverse and height are the actual fixed-reference composites; the principal field and potential use the real coordinate formulas for these same maps.
The final interior-division constructor uses the new raw coefficients and new canonical endpoints.
limits: This record definition and its field equalities are not themselves a geometry, transmission or material certificate.
The old relative whole atlas remains an intermediate only.
